claims.summary: Michaelis classifies gostar as VTI and records the example Meu filho gosta de dormir com claridade, with de before the infinitive.
Michaelis records the quoted gostar examples and labels the verb VTI.
The RAE/ASALE glossary describes the experiencer complement of gustar as indirect object and gives le gusta el mar / me gustan los helados, with subject-verb agreement.

The cited sources document a Portuguese gostar de complement pattern and Spanish gustar with an indirect object and agreement with the liked subject; the article limits generalization to those documented patterns.
